title: Cotton Club productions and writers
summary: Clarence Robinson and writers like Harold Arlen kept the shows coming.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What kinds of shows did you all do there.

Productions, because the producer, he had a guy called Clarence Robinson, was assistant to Leonard and every year he would go to Europe and see the different shows, they would come back and give ideas to our show. We had special writers, Harold Arlen, Jimmy McHugh and Dorothy Fields. They were writers, they were on the staff, that's right. It was production, man, just like Ziegfeld put on a production. That's what we put on there. We had that.
